---
title: "Introduction to Positron and Posit Assistant"
---

[Positron](https://positron.posit.co) is a next-generation data science IDE from
[Posit](https://posit.co) that combines ideas from RStudio and Visual Studio
Code. [Posit Assistant](https://positron.posit.co/assistant.html) is the AI
assistant built into Positron.

## Before the workshop

Install Positron and check that it can run R:

* Latest release: <https://positron.posit.co/download.html>
* Pre-releases: <https://github.com/posit-dev/positron/releases>
* Detailed setup: <https://posit-dev.github.io/positron-workshop/setup.html>

## Positron

We work through the [Positron workshop](https://posit-dev.github.io/positron-workshop/),
which I have taught with colleagues throughout 2025. The 2026 materials will
appear there; in the meantime, last year's RaukR page shows the shape of it:

<https://posit-dev.github.io/positron-workshop/raukr.html>

short link: <http://pos.it/ron-raukr>

## Posit Assistant

[Posit Assistant](https://positron.posit.co/assistant.html) is the AI coding
experience in Positron, bringing together what used to be Positron Assistant and
Databot. The documentation is the place to start and the place to return to:

* Overview and feature summary: <https://positron.posit.co/assistant.html>
* Setup and everything else: <https://pos.it/assistant-docs>

Note that Posit Assistant supersedes the older Positron Assistant, so beware of
older material, including a walkthrough
[comparing the two](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y9P2nlFXKnQ).

## Going further

[Introduction to Positron](https://academy.posit.co/path/introduction-to-positron),
three self-paced courses on Posit Academy.

[Applied statistics with R](https://juliasilge.github.io/applied-stats-byu-2026/)
